Description.SourceString:
Observation log: As the saying goes, Sir, the enemy of your enemy is your friend.

We chose to reveal ourselves to the giant, five-headed dragon. It was a moment for our history books, if I may be so audacious. I removed my disguise, and she was immediately taken aback. She thought that I was a simple decorative cactus, but clearly she was incorrect. And thus began a great meeting of minds, Sir. 

At one point, we reached something of an impasse. She wished to know about our mission, but I would not disclose sensitive matters, even to an eater of gods. So we came to a compromise: I inducted her as a temporary KGP agent, and gave her level-3 clearance. At that level, she could have a base outline of our mission, without revealing the meaty bits that would get me court-martialed by your good self, Sir. 

I hope this was an adequate response. A person of her standing would be quite the coup for the KGP, even as a potential informant. I await your reaction.

Threat assessment: Low - We have a valuable ally here, Sir.

End of report.

- Agent Ravioli
